Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
Sponsor: Wheeler
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 317 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment, which, if ratified, would provide for term limits for legislators.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
